builds.name: Fort-syth
builds.desc:
This build focuses on Forsyth's great Def/Res and turning him into a decent mixed phase unit.
His Prf, Sol Lance, allows him to recover HP whenever an enemy manages to deal damage to him, which will be helpful should you decide to run Quick Riposte on him.
You can keep his base kit Special, Bonfire, as his Def will allow him to hit huge, but I personally run Ignis, because Bold Fighter will get either Special in two hits most of the time.
Fort. Def/Res allows him to gain even more bulk at very little cost. His base attack with his Prf is 56, and Fort. Def/Res only drops that down to 54.
Bold Fighter is a part of Forsyth's base kit, but it works very well for him: it completely ignores his god-awful Spd stat and allows his special to proc faster.
As always, you have many options for the C skill. Joint Hone will allow Forsyth to become even bulkier without losing Armor March (Granted that you're running that on your team), but it's entirely dependent on what you think will be best.
Quick Riposte is a great Sacred Seal option if you want Forsyth to be better at dealing damage to foes in the enemy phase, but you can always go with Def/Res Bond to tank even more damage.
